Card Q&A.a: "*Also treat as if name is [Sistermon Noir] and traits include [Virus]" is a special rule for this card, not an effect. Therefore, this text also applies when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to "*Also treat as if name is [Sistermon Noir] and traits include [Virus]" on this card when it is in my hand or breeding area?

Card Q&A.a: This card is treated as having both the [Virus] and [Data] traits, but only 1 at a time, so it is treated as having 3 traits in total, 1 of them together with the [Champion] and [Puppet] traits.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card have the 4 traits, [Champion], [Puppet], [Virus] and [Data]?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] in its traits among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
[All Turns] All of your Digimon with [Huckmon] in their names and [Royal Knight] in their traits gain ＜Reboot＞. (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
*Also treat as if name is [Sistermon Noir] and traits include [Virus].
